claim: `bend.raised.underSpan`'s line does not fit the case round 6 added. §7.1's row (l. 10675) and §2.7's way-and-channel table row (b)'s gates cell now send a hand way 'crossing an enceinte's trace inside that strip' to `bend.raised.underSpan`, its crossing of the trace 'moved along the deck to the nearest crossing clear of the strip'. V09 §4.9's row (l. 2104) copies that source cell, but its one line, '{name} passes under {way} through its nearest open arch, {m} m off your line.', words only the arch case. A road moved to cross the wall at a gate clear of the deck's strip is told it passes through an arch. The key, its event and the bend are the same, so nothing built changes; the sentence is wrong for the case (T-V9-52's 'a road drawn across that wall there crosses it clear of the strip, with `bend.raised.underSpan`').
required_change: V09. (1) §4.9's `bend.raised.underSpan` row, after its line, adds: '— and, for a way whose crossing of a wall's trace was moved clear of the under-deck strip, "{name} crosses {wall} at a gate clear of {way}, {m} m off your line." (`{wall}` as in `bend.wall.raisedCrossing`'s gate form) — the line taking its form by what was moved'. (2) T-V9-52: 'a road drawn across that wall there crosses it clear of the strip, with `bend.raised.underSpan`' adds ' in its wall form'.
